newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Household Intl rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Household Intl rating cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it lowered its six-month rating on Household International Inc to market performer from outperform, noting that the stock was fairly valued for the intermediate term. It continues to rate the stock as outperform for the long term.

-- The stock has risen 42.6 percent year to date and 67.3 percent from its 52-week low, EVEREN noted in a report. EVEREN said it maintains its intermediate price target of $88 and long-term target of $106.
-- Household International was trading at 85-7/8, off 2-1/8.
